item.title: Warriors add JC All-America DE and combo punter/kicker
item.description: The Hawaii football team received a boost with the addition of a former junior college All-America defensive end and a combo punter/kicker.

item.title: Campbell basketball team clamps down on Kalani to win OIA D-I title
item.description: Defense travels well for the Campbell Sabers.

item.title: ‘Iolani rallies to oust Maryknoll, clinch second ILH state spot
item.description: Hailey Fernandez scored 15 points and dished seven assists, while Justice Kekauoha had nine of her 11 points in the second half as host ‘Iolani rallied past Maryknoll, 50-41, in the Interscholastic League of Honolulu second-place tiebreaker game on Wednesday night.

item.title: Purple reigns as Pearl City defeats Kaiser to capture OIA D-II crown
item.description: Purple people power reigns in the OIA again.

item.title: Punahou boys edge Kamehameha on PKs to earn state soccer berth
item.description: The Punahou boys soccer team had the sun setting overhead and knew it was time to shine through.

item.description: TOKYO >> Students and parents are flocking to Yushima Tenmangu shrine in Bunkyo ward, Tokyo, to pray for success as entrance exam season gets underway.

item.title: Honolulu City Council adopts new transit fares
item.description: The Honolulu City Council on a split vote Wednesday moved to increase fares for riders of TheBus, TheHandi-Van and Skyline.

item.title: The Wahine hope to keep rolling against first-place UC Irvine
item.description: If there is one game to point to where the Hawaii women’s basketball season changed for the better, it wasn’t the first of the Rainbow Wahine’s current four-game winning streak.
